en: So as you work on projects with Claude Code,
from time to time you might wanna use Claude
Code to perform a code review because of
course it can also take a look at your code
or
the code it wrote, I guess,
and give you some feedback on that.
So you might wanna send a prompt like this
to Claude Code or maybe a more elaborate one
where you describe in a bit more detail how
that code review should be performed. The
problem with this approach is, however, that
you probably wanna
perform code reviews over and over again
from time to time. Not all the time, but
maybe every day or so. So you will probably
repeat that prompt from time to time. And if
it's just one sentence, that's not too bad,
but what if it should be more elaborate?
That's where custom commands come into play.
Just as you can add agents and skills to
your Claude setup, you can also add custom
commands, which are in a nutshell, just
reusable prompts. You can add them locally
in your project as I'm doing it here, or
again, globally in your
user Claude folder.
